title: The Fourth Expedition
body:
# The Fourth Expedition

The fourth Expedition is nearly upon us, and it arrives with some notable changes. With every Expedition we run, we take away lessons and search for ways to improve things. This time, that means overhauling the reward structure.

**Finish your fourth Expedition and you'll unlock the first level of the new Zenith Outfit. Take on the Expedition Challenge, and rather than earning Skill Points, you'll now collect Blueprints to give your Topside adventures a head start along with Raider Tokens to keep your look sharp at every stage.**

# **TIMING**

The departure window opens on the 7th of July at 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT and closes on the 21st of July at 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT. You get 14 days to sign up and meet the requirements, and every player who signs up will depart automatically once the window closes.

As with every past Expedition, finishing your Caravan is not the same as signing up for the Expedition — you still need to sign up separately during the window. The 'last call' feature returns for this Expedition as well, in case the window slips past you.

**Expeditions represent a personal progression path that players work through in sequence. You can work on the Caravan at any time between Expedition windows, but you can only finish the Expedition itself during its scheduled window.**

# **HOW TO DO THE EXPEDITION**

* **Complete the Caravan** You can begin contributing to the Caravan the moment you finish your previous Expedition. If this is your very first Expedition, you're free to start contributing straight away.

* **Wait for the Expedition Window** The next window runs from July 7th at 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT through July 21st at 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.

* **Sign Up** Once the window opens, make sure you sign up.

* **Complete the Challenge** To receive the rewards, you must complete a challenge within the Expedition Window (details further below).

* **Catch Up** If you're on your second, third or fourth Expedition, you can make up for missed skill points, up to a maximum of 5 per Expedition (details further below).

* **Depart** Everyone who signed up departs on July 21st at 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.

# **REWARDS**

Your rewards depend on where you are in your personal progression. If this is your first, second or third Expedition, check your specific rewards for that stage.

## **Mystery Rewards**

Players on their fourth Expedition will no longer receive Skill Points from the Expedition Challenge. Instead, you'll be given Blueprints and Raider Tokens once you depart.

How many rewards you get depends on the amount of damage you deal during the departure window, using the same thresholds as the last Expedition. Unlike Skill Points, there is no catch-up mechanic for these rewards.

This marks the first trial run of the Mystery Reward system, and we'll be watching closely to see how it plays out and reviewing your feedback. As always, adjustments may follow as we keep working to improve things.

To unlock all five Bonus Rewards, you'll need to hit these damage thresholds before the departure window shuts:

* Reward 1: Deal 5,000 total damage

* Reward 2: Deal 10,000 total damage

* Reward 3: Deal 30,000 total damage

* Reward 4: Deal 50,000 total damage

* Reward 5: Deal 100,000 total damage

Every departure objective you complete grants you one Blueprint. Note that these Blueprints don't stick around — they reset when you depart on your next Expedition. The Damage Challenge rewards won't give you duplicates, so you won't receive the same Blueprint twice from this system. That said, this duplicate protection doesn't cover Blueprints you've already stored in Ermal's Vault.

Completing each departure objective also earns you 150 Raider Tokens. Unlike the Blueprints, these Tokens are permanent and carry over into your next Expedition.

## **Permanent**

**Cosmetics:**

* With the Patchwork Outfit now finished, completing your fourth Expedition unlocks the first step of the Zenith Outfit.

**Bonuses:**

* +12 stash space (bringing the total extra to 48 by the 4th Expedition), reaching its cap of 60 with the 5th Expedition.

* The bonus skill points earned from Expeditions cap out at 15. You can still catch up on skill points you missed previously, and this remains tied to your stash value. The catch-up option becomes available starting with your second Expedition, and once you've reached the full 15 skill points, catch-up is no longer offered.

## **Consecutive buffs**

Raiders who keep completing Expeditions back-to-back earn consecutive buffs. The XP boost, the Scrappy materials boost and the repair value increase all cap at three levels — so if you're on your fourth Expedition in a row, your boosted values stay at what you reached on your third Expedition rather than climbing further.

Skipping an Expedition window won't erase your progress, but it does mean the buffs won't increase for the following Expedition period. The buff itself also goes inactive for the duration of the Expedition you missed.

You need two consecutive Expeditions to raise your buff level, which means completing your third Expedition in a row grants you all three levels of the consecutive buffs. If you missed exactly one Expedition window (other than the very first one), you should currently be sitting at the second level of consecutive buffs.

## **Ermal's Vault**

Through Ermal, you can purchase up to five Expedition Vault Slots, letting you store items you want to carry forward into your Expedition.

## **Trials**

Just as with the previous Expedition, the new Trials Season begins the moment the Expedition window opens.

## **New Raiders & Future Expeditions**

We recognize that it's frustrating for new players who are only just beginning their Expeditions now. We're working to strike the right balance between rewarding our veteran players and giving newer players fair, enjoyable ways to catch up so they don't feel permanently behind. This is an ongoing effort, and we'll keep sharing updates as there's more to tell.

Let us know your thoughts on these changes and how they play out in practice, and keep sending feedback about what you'd like to see going forward.

See you Topside, //Ossen And The ARC Raiders Team
